purpose: Reclaim disposable inactive public build assets after root filesystem exhaustion
scope: Only manifest-authenticated public SDK/runtime/artifact files within the explicit inactive-release allowlist. All affected releases carry runtimeUsable:false markers and must not be reused as runtime sources.
guards: Fresh unit/config/process/current-pointer release references protected; rechecked unchanged after hash validation.
Only regular root-owned confined files matching retained SDK or wallet manifest hashes removed.
Public UI runtime.json, all configs, credentials, dependency trees and by-hash assets retained.
limitations: Available-space delta includes concurrent filesystem activity; it is the observed before/after difference, not a theoretical sum.
Inactive source trees and metadata remain; this is public-asset reclamation, not complete release-directory removal.
followup: Normal publication now preflights filesystem capacity and removes verified uploaded payload copies after success.
